name: Bypass ATS: Engineering Manager
subject: Quick question regarding {targetRole} at {targetCompany}
template:
Hi {recipientName},

I noticed {targetCompany} is expanding the engineering team and hiring for the {targetRole} position. Instead of just dropping my resume in the ATS portal, I wanted to reach out directly.

I recently solved a similar technical challenge: {proofPoint}.

Given the overlap between what you're building and my recent work, I'd love to chat briefly to see if there's a mutual fit. Are you open to a quick 10-minute call later this week?

Best regards,
{candidateName}
{portfolioLink}
description: A direct, value-driven cold email to a hiring manager highlighting a specific technical proof point.

name: Bypass ATS: Short & Punchy
subject: {targetRole} candidate w/ {primarySkill} experience
description: A very concise cold email for busy engineering managers.

name: LinkedIn Connect: Direct
template: Hi {recipientName}, I saw {targetCompany} is hiring a {targetRole}. I recently accomplished: {proofPoint}. I'd love to connect and see if my background in {primarySkill} aligns with what your team needs right now. Thanks, {candidateName}
description: A strict <300 char LinkedIn connection request that immediately gets to the point.

name: LinkedIn Connect: Alumni
template: Hi {recipientName}, fellow {collegeName} grad here! I'm applying for the {targetRole} role at {targetCompany} and have strong experience in {primarySkill}. I'd love to connect to hear your thoughts on the engineering culture there. Best, {candidateName}
description: Leverages university common ground under the 300 character limit.

name: Post-Referral Check-in
subject: Following up on referral for {targetRole} - {candidateName}
template:
Hi {recipientName},

I recently applied for the {targetRole} position at {targetCompany} via a referral from {commonGround}.

Since submitting my application, I've continued building my expertise in {primarySkill} and wanted to reiterate my strong interest in joining the team.

Please let me know if you need any additional information or work samples (my portfolio is at {portfolioLink}). 

Looking forward to potentially speaking with you.

Best,
{candidateName}
description: Professional follow-up email after an internal employee has referred you.
